name: alm-bench-long-q
description: A dataset that evaluates language models on answering long, information-dense questions requiring sustained context handling and multi-step reasoning across extended inputs. It measures models' ability to produce coherent, correct long-form answers rather than short factoid replies. Primarily intended to stress long-context comprehension and reasoning rather than surface-level QA.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset used in long-context/long-question evaluations; limited but growing recognition among researchers focusing on long-context LLM evaluation.
